value: Arc is a browser designed to anticipate user needs, offering a clean, calm, and highly customizable experience that adapts to individual usage patterns. It provides robust organizational tools like Spaces and Profiles to effortlessly manage different online activities—from work to hobbies—and further personalization options such as Split View and Themes. Crucially, Arc prioritizes user privacy and security, built from the ground up to operate without tracking browsing history or search data.
